download_s2ef_data: run the download_data script to download and preprocess an S2EF dataset split like 200k or all
download_is2re_data: run the download_data script to download and extract the IS2RE dataset to a specified data path
run_get_data: run the get_data function to download a task dataset split and clean up intermediate files
run_uncompress_data: run the uncompress_data function to decompress a compressed S2EF data directory using the uncompress module
run_preprocess_data: run the preprocess_data function to preprocess uncompressed S2EF data into the output path using preprocess_ef
